title: Babette's jokes on Kid Ory
summary: Mrs. Ory tells how Babette plays with the name Kid.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: An even funnier one than that that she pulled. About a month ago, she pointed to Daddy, she says, Kid Ory. And then she pointed in where I was, I was in my bedroom at the time, she says, Kid Mommy. And she pointed her side and says, Kid me. Don't kid me. Kid did me.
